name: Battle Pets TD
seoDescription: Find the latest Battle Pets TD codes to claim free Coins and rare pets, helping you build a stronger team and explore islands with less grind.
introMd: Battle Pets TD lets you explore islands, hatch pets, and battle waves of enemies using your team. Codes in the game give you free Coins and pets to strengthen your lineup. Using Battle Pets TD codes can help you get rare pets and extra resources without grinding too long, making your adventure smoother and more fun.
redeemMd:
## How to Redeem Battle Pets TD Codes
You don’t need to meet any special requirements to redeem codes. Just follow these steps:
1. [[roblox_link|Launch Battle Pets TD]] on Roblox.
2. Click the ABX button at the bottom-left corner of the screen.
3. Enter your code in the ENTER CODE HERE text box.
4. Press Enter to claim your rewards immediately.
rewardsMd:
## What Rewards You Normally Get?
Codes in Battle Pets TD mostly grant resources and pets that help you build a stronger team. Here’s what you can expect:

| Reward Type | Description |
|-------------|-------------|
| Coins       | Currency used to buy eggs and upgrades for your pets. |
| Pets        | New companions hatched from eggs to add to your battle team. |
| Accessories | Items to boost your pets’ power and stats (earned through crafting, not codes). |

Coins and pets are the main freebies from codes, letting you expand your team and improve your chances in battles across islands.
troubleshootMd:
## Why Codes Might Not Work
Codes in Battle Pets TD expire quickly after release, so timing is key. Make sure you copy and paste codes exactly to avoid typos. There are no level or progress restrictions, so if a code doesn’t work, it’s likely expired or entered incorrectly.
findCodesMd:
## Where to Find New Battle Pets TD Codes
New codes usually drop on the official Battle Pets TD Discord server, the Spectral Roblox Guilded server, and the Spectral Roblox group on Roblox. The developer shares codes there during updates or special events. Check these channels often for fresh codes. Developer socials are listed below the game.
